item.title: Sotto 0.2.5
item.description:
• Updated the on-device language model runtime (llama.cpp); no change to your text.
  • Compiling your voice profile is now one click: no quote review, no confirmation. Delete a dictation from History to keep it out.
  • The voice profile now keeps only what you control by speaking: punctuation figures like exclamation marks, dashes and emoji are gone.
